title: [FEAT]: Added a ? query parameters to the /apps route of the pollinations ecosystem
author: Circuit-Overtime
pr_body_excerpt:
## Changes Made:- 

Adds an "All" genre (default), a ?query-synced search bar (name/description/author), centers the category + sort rows, moves the badge legend beneath the sort tags, and adds a third top "Docs" card while removing the inline docs link.

gist.headline: The app garden got a map
gist.blurb: The ecosystem page can now remember what you were looking for. Search apps by name, description, or author, then share the exact trail through the garden.
gist.summary: The /apps page now syncs its name, description, and author search to a ?query URL parameter, adds an All genre as the default filter, centers category and sort controls, and promotes Docs into a third top card.
gist.impact: People can link directly to a filtered app search and browse the ecosystem with a clearer default view, reorganized controls, and faster access to documentation.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a tiny garden librarian, using a magnifying glass over a lush app garden while a retro terminal displays a URL search query. Three welcoming signpost cards represent Apps, Community, and Docs; labeled flower beds represent genres, with the All bed centered at the entrance.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute pixel bee mascot with a tiny librarian hat and magnifying glass, searching a blooming code-garden of app cards while a retro CRT monitor shows a simple URL with '?query=' in chunky pixel text. Three friendly signpost cards, including a prominent 'DOCS' card, stand among centered genre flower beds; lime green (#ecf874) appears prominently with warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach pastel gradients, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
